hero.label: The Archive · Volume I
hero.headline: Every image here
hero.sub: An archive of original photographs, each catalogued, sealed and licensed directly from the photographer.

manifesto.label: A note from the maker
manifesto.body: In an age where anyone can generate an image, provenance is the product. Every photograph in this archive was taken with a physical camera, in a real place, on a real day. The RAW file is kept. The record is kept. Nothing is generated. Nothing is composited.
manifesto.sig: Beta Art · Archive of verified human photography

verification.title: How each work is verified.
verification.intro: A photograph is only as trustworthy as the record behind it. Every plate in the archive carries three forms of evidence — the same standard applied to museum holdings and archival collections.

items.headline: The RAW original is archived.
items.description: Every plate begins as a RAW file from a real camera. The originals are stored in an offline archive, available for inspection on request.

items.headline: The capture record travels with the image.
items.description: Camera, lens, exposure, place and date accompany each photograph. Where the equipment supports it, C2PA Content Credentials are embedded at capture.

items.headline: The license is signed by the maker.
items.description: You license directly from the photographer. Each order arrives with a written license, a proper invoice, and a numbered certificate — no intermediaries.

about.label: The photographer
about.headline: I photograph
paragraphs: Fjords before sunrise, cities after rain, faces that agreed to be seen. Nothing on this site was generated, composited or hallucinated by a machine.

My archive holds more than 84,000 frames captured since 2012. When you license a plate, you deal with me directly — a written license, a proper invoice, and the full-resolution file delivered to your inbox within twenty-four hours.
If you want to see the RAW file behind any plate, ask. That's the point.
